messages:
alex: async check-in — what I did: dug into the 02:14 alert (503s). Root cause looks like transient redis connection flaps on two dedicated shards. Temporarily bumped connection pool limits and the error rate dropped.

alex: blocker: need a proper client backoff + retry change in the runtime library; will require a short canary rollout. Need a 30m window for canary and a rollback plan.

oncall-bot: ALERT: high 5xx rate detected 02:14 UTC -> pager triggered. Pager cleared 02:47 UTC.

maya: thanks alex. I filed infra ticket INFRA-3124 for the client change and linked initial logs. Can you add explicit rollback steps to the PR?

alex: added rollback steps in PR https://git.company/repo/pull/456 — includes commands and how to revert pool change. pinging @liam for review.

liam: saw the PR, will do a review around 12:30 UTC. quick Q: did we breach SLOs or just spike?

alex: SLOs: short blip. 99.9% latency SLO largely intact but error budget used ~0.03% extra in last 24h. no immediate breach, but worth tightening backoff.

morgan: +1 for a controlled canary. approve 16:00 UTC window for a 30m canary. propose adding a temporary alert suppression for synthetic checks during that 20m deploy window.

maya: I can open the alert suppression PR in ops-alerting; will set it to auto-expire after 30m.

liam: left two small nits on the PR (logging verbosity and one retry timeout). after those fixed I'll approve and we can schedule canary.

alex: fixed nits, bumped backoff jitter to reduce thundering herd. added a short rollout doc (ops/rollouts/redis-client-backoff.md) with steps and verification queries.

morgan: nice. can someone paste the validation commands we'll run during canary?

alex: validation: `curl -sS https://metrics.company/_status | jq .redis_errors` then `grep "conn_closed" /var/log/redis-proxy.log | tail -n 50`. also run synthetic smoke against a non-critical route.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: 02:47 UTC — summary: transient redis connection flaps, mitigated by pool bump; follow-up action: runtime client backoff PR and canary.

alex: today: merge PR after review, coordinate canary at 16:00 UTC, update runbook with new backoff section. will post a short postmortem if the canary shows other regressions. :thumbsup:

maya: I'll take the alert suppression PR and own monitoring changes.

liam: will review and approve this morning. ping if you need extra hands for rollback testing.

alex: thanks all — will update thread when canary starts and when it's complete.
